hook: TG-RERA fines a Kondapur developer *₹15 lakh* for selling before registering
hook_b: TG-RERA fines a Kondapur developer *₹15 lakh* for selling before registering
tldr: In two Nov 10 orders, Telangana RERA ruled that later registration or layout approval cannot cure sales made without RERA registration.

beats.what: Atluri Developers was fined for agreeing to sell a seventh-floor unit at Atluri Ascend, Kondapur, before the project got RERA registration on Dec 14, 2022.
beats.why: RERA held that agreeing to sell an identified unit before registration breaks Section 3(1), however the agreement is described.
beats.care: In a second order, a Mancherial plot promoter was fined ₹5.3 lakh: DTCP layout approval was ruled no substitute for RERA registration.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Times of India (Nov 18): Both penalties must be paid into the TG RERA Fund within 30 days, or face action under Section 63.
